items.title: Florida Packing
items.content_html:
Packing notes #

  • girls don’t need their sleeping bags
  • I don’t need my BJJ stuff

My inventory #

  • 4 pairs sleeping underwear + shorts = 4 t-shirts
  • 2 hoodies (1 light 1 heavy)
  • orange 1/4 zip
  • 2 pair socks (more if forecast is sub 70)
  • 1 pair swimming trunks is probably enough
  • 2 shorts
